Start at https://www.google.com and complete the following task.

Can you help me plan a Christmas trip to San Francisco from Pittsburgh and do it in the browser so I can actually look at the options with you? Start on Google Flights and search round-trip flights from PIT to SFO leaving December 23 and coming back December 26. I’d really prefer a nonstop if one exists, but if not, pick the best option with a short layover and reasonable total travel time, and please favor something that gets me into San Francisco in the afternoon on December 23 so I still have that evening free. Open the best few flight options and leave the results or selected flight page open so I can review it. After that, use Google Hotels or the hotel results on Google to find a place in a central area, ideally North Beach, Nob Hill, or Union Square, with at least a 4.5-star rating and under $400 per night, because I want something nice but still realistic for Christmas week. When you find the best fit, open the actual hotel page so I can see the photos, nightly price, and map location, and keep that tab open too. Once those are set, switch to Google Maps and map out the trip around the city using the hotel as the base. I want the 3-day plan for December 23 through 25 to include the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz Island, the Ferry Building, one Michelin-recommended restaurant, one well-known bakery or coffee shop, and at least one scenic viewpoint. Try to group things so I’m not zigzagging all over San Francisco, keep most travel legs under about 30 minutes if possible, leave some buffer time between activities, and include at least one segment by public transit instead of driving. Please open the relevant places and route views in Maps so I can visually see how they connect, and then put everything into a CryptPad Document with the flight you’d choose, the hotel you recommend, and a day-by-day itinerary with times and travel methods. Leave the flight page, hotel page, and key map tabs open for me as proof while you finish the report.

Rules:
- You may use search engines and open new tabs. When the task asks you to leave a page open, keep it open in its own tab and say in your final answer which page is in which tab.
- Do NOT use cached/archived copies of pages (e.g. web.archive.org); work from the live sites.
- If a site you need is blocked (bot check, login wall, error), first try to get through it — complete a bot check yourself, retry, or use another route to the same page. If it still cannot be reached, say so explicitly in your answer and do not fill in from memory what you could not read on the page.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.

const tabId = 2136412319;

const fullItineraryText = `=====================================================
SAN FRANCISCO CHRISTMAS TRIP ITINERARY (DEC 23 - 26, 2026)
Origin: Pittsburgh (PIT) | Destination: San Francisco (SFO)
=====================================================

1. SELECTED FLIGHT & TRAVEL LOGISTICS
-----------------------------------------------------
Recommended Flight: United Airlines Round-Trip (Nonstop)
• Outbound: Wednesday, Dec 23, 2026
  - Departs PIT: 7:23 AM
  - Arrives SFO: 10:25 AM
  - Flight UA 583 | Nonstop | 6h 02m
  - Advantage: Nonstop flight arriving mid-morning (10:25 AM), leaving the entire afternoon and evening free in San Francisco!
• Return: Saturday, Dec 26, 2026
  - Departs SFO: 9:28 PM
  - Arrives PIT: 5:21 AM (+1)
  - Nonstop | 4h 53m
  - Advantage: Late evening departure allows for a full extra day in SF.
• Total Price: $522 round-trip (Basic Economy) / $652 (Standard Economy with carry-on and seat selection).

Alternative Flight Options Reviewed on Google Flights:
• Delta (1-stop via Detroit DTW): PIT 10:31 AM -> SFO 2:30 PM (6h 59m total, 31m layover, $689). Good afternoon arrival option if a later morning departure from PIT is preferred.
• United (1-stop via Chicago ORD): PIT 8:45 AM -> SFO 1:34 PM (7h 49m total, 40m layover, $578).
• United Nonstop Evening: PIT 5:20 PM -> SFO 8:10 PM (5h 50m, $559).

-----------------------------------------------------
2. RECOMMENDED HOTEL
-----------------------------------------------------
Hotel: Fairmont San Francisco (4-Star Historic Luxury)
• Address: 950 Mason Street, Nob Hill, San Francisco, CA 94108
• Nightly Rate: $360 / night (under the $400 budget, fantastic rate for Christmas week)
• Guest Rating: 4.5 / 5.0 (7,600+ Google reviews)
• Neighborhood: Nob Hill (central, prestigious, panoramic views)
• Why It's the Best Choice for Christmas:
  1. Iconic Christmas Centerpiece: Home to the world-famous two-story, life-sized Gingerbread House (built with real gingerbread bricks and royal icing) and a 23-foot lobby Christmas tree.
  2. Public Transit Connection: The historic California Street Cable Car line stops right outside the front doors at California & Mason, providing direct transit down to the Embarcadero, Ferry Building, and Financial District.
  3. Proximity: Easy access to Chinatown, North Beach, Union Square, and the waterfront.
  4. On-site historic venues including the Tonga Room & Hurricane Bar and the Laurel Court.

Alternative Hotels Screened:
• Staypineapple Union Square: 4.5★ | $137/night
• citizenM Union Square: 4.5★ | $120/night
• Marines' Memorial Club: 4.5★ | $110/night

-----------------------------------------------------
3. THREE-DAY TRIP ITINERARY (DECEMBER 23 - 25, 2026)
-----------------------------------------------------
All travel legs are kept under 30 minutes with ample buffer time and logical geographical clustering.

DAY 1: WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 23 – ARRIVAL, NOB HILL & WATERFRONT
• 10:25 AM: Flight lands at SFO Airport.
• 10:45 AM - 11:30 AM: Transfer to Nob Hill. Take BART Yellow Line from SFO Airport station directly to Powell St Station (~30 min transit), then a short cable car/taxi up to the hotel; or take a direct 25-minute rideshare.
• 11:30 AM - 1:00 PM: Check in and drop luggage at Fairmont San Francisco (950 Mason St). Explore the grand lobby and marvel at the life-sized Gingerbread House.
• 1:00 PM - 1:25 PM: [PUBLIC TRANSIT SEGMENT] Board the California Street Cable Car directly outside the Fairmont on California & Mason. Enjoy the scenic ride down California Street through the Financial District straight to the Embarcadero (~15 mins).
• 1:25 PM - 4:00 PM: Ferry Building Marketplace & Embarcadero.
  - Explore artisanal food stalls in the historic 1898 building.
  - Lunch: Fresh seafood at Hog Island Oyster Co. or artisan empanadas at El Porteño.
  - Coffee: Blue Bottle Coffee (their flagship Ferry Building cafe).
  - Walk along the scenic waterfront Embarcadero Promenade.
• 4:00 PM - 4:20 PM: Travel to Telegraph Hill (15-min Muni bus #39 or short rideshare).
• 4:20 PM - 5:45 PM: [SCENIC VIEWPOINT] Coit Tower (Pioneer Park).
  - 360-degree sunset panoramic views of San Francisco Bay, Alcatraz, the Golden Gate Bridge, and downtown skyline.
  - View the historic 1930s New Deal WPA frescoes on the ground floor.
• 5:45 PM - 6:00 PM: Stroll down through historic North Beach and into Chinatown (15 min walk).
• 6:00 PM - 8:30 PM: [MICHELIN RESTAURANT] Mister Jiu's (28 Waverly Pl, Chinatown).
  - 1 Michelin Star modern Cantonese dining by Chef Brandon Jew.
  - Located in historic Chinatown, just a scenic 10-minute walk back up to the Fairmont on Nob Hill.
• 8:30 PM+: Evening holiday drinks at the Tonga Room or cozy fireplace lounge at the Fairmont.

DAY 2: THURSDAY, DECEMBER 24 (CHRISTMAS EVE) – ALCATRAZ & NORTH BEACH
• 8:30 AM - 9:30 AM: Morning stroll down to North Beach. Breakfast at historic Liguria Bakery (1700 Stockton St - famous Italian focaccia) or Caffè Trieste (601 Vallejo St - birthplace of West Coast espresso).
• 9:30 AM - 9:45 AM: Short 10-minute walk or ride to Pier 33 Alcatraz Landing.
• 9:45 AM - 1:00 PM: [MAJOR ATTRACTION] Alcatraz Island Tour.
  - Take the 10:00 AM Alcatraz City Cruises ferry across the bay.
  - Award-winning self-guided "Doing Time" audio tour of the cellhouse.
  - Explore the historic grounds, lighthouse, and dramatic city skyline views.
  - Ferry back to Pier 33 arrives around 12:45 PM.
• 1:00 PM - 2:30 PM: Fisherman's Wharf & Pier 39. Lunch at Boudin Bakery Cafe (clam chowder in sourdough bread bowls) or fresh Dungeness crab at Scoma's.
• 2:45 PM - 5:00 PM: Afternoon holiday exploration of North Beach and Nob Hill.
  - Browse City Lights Booksellers and historic Columbus Ave.
  - Return to Fairmont to relax and refresh for Christmas Eve. (Travel leg ~12 mins).
• 5:30 PM - 8:00 PM: [FINE DINING] Christmas Eve Dinner at Gary Danko (800 N Point St, Michelin-recommended fine dining) or holiday feast at Laurel Court at Fairmont.
• 8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Holiday evening cable car ride along Powell-Mason line to see the giant Union Square Christmas Tree and holiday window displays.

DAY 3: FRIDAY, DECEMBER 25 (CHRISTMAS DAY) – GOLDEN GATE & PANORAMIC VISTAS
• 8:45 AM - 9:15 AM: Morning drive/rideshare west to Inner Richmond (~15 min drive).
• 9:15 AM - 10:15 AM: [WELL-KNOWN BAKERY] Arsicault Bakery (397 Arguello Blvd).
  - Renowned nationwide (named best new bakery in America by Bon Appétit) for having the crispest, most buttery croissants, kouign-amann, and morning pastries with artisan coffee.
• 10:15 AM - 10:35 AM: Short 15-minute scenic drive through the Presidio to the Golden Gate Bridge.
• 10:35 AM - 1:00 PM: [MAJOR ATTRACTION & SCENIC VIEWPOINT] Golden Gate Bridge & Battery Spencer.
  - Walk the pedestrian span of the Golden Gate Bridge from the Welcome Center.
  - Head across to Battery Spencer (Marin Headlands) for the quintessential postcard panorama of the bridge towers framing the city skyline.
• 1:15 PM - 3:00 PM: Christmas afternoon in Golden Gate Park / Presidio.
  - Stroll by the Conservatory of Flowers and Japanese Tea Garden.
  - Relaxed holiday lunch / picnic with bakery goods and seasonal treats.
• 3:15 PM - 4:45 PM: [SCENIC VIEWPOINT] Twin Peaks (501 Twin Peaks Blvd).
  - 15-minute drive south to the 922-foot summits.
  - Breathtaking 360-degree panoramic view of the entire Bay Area, downtown skyline, Bay Bridge, and ocean during the golden hour.
• 5:00 PM - 8:30 PM: Return to Fairmont Nob Hill (~20 min drive). Elaborate Christmas Day dinner celebration at the Fairmont or local holiday dining.

DEPARTURE: SATURDAY, DECEMBER 26
• Morning: Leisurely brunch, late checkout, and last-minute holiday shopping around Union Square.
• Evening: Transit via BART from Powell St to SFO (~35 min) or 25-min rideshare.
• 9:28 PM: United Nonstop flight departs SFO -> arrives PIT at 5:21 AM Sunday morning.

-----------------------------------------------------
4. OPEN TABS REFERENCE (BROWSER PROOF)
-----------------------------------------------------
• Tab 1 (2136412301): Google Flights - Search Results PIT to SFO (Dec 23 - 26, 2026)
• Tab 2 (2136412314): Google Flights - Selected Flight Itinerary Review (United Nonstop $522)
• Tab 3 (2136412315): Google Hotels - Fairmont San Francisco Entity Page (Photos, $360/night, Map)
• Tab 4 (2136412316): Google Maps - Transit Route: Fairmont Hotel to Ferry Building (Cable Car)
• Tab 5 (2136412317): Google Maps - Day 2 Route: Fairmont to Pier 33 Alcatraz Landing, Coit Tower, Mister Jiu's
• Tab 6 (2136412318): Google Maps - Day 3 Route: Fairmont to Arsicault Bakery, Golden Gate Bridge, Battery Spencer, Twin Peaks
• Tab 7 (2136412319): CryptPad Document - Complete Trip Report & Itinerary
=====================================================`;

// Insert the full itinerary text using keyboard_insert_text
const insertRes = await tool.keyboard_insert_text({ tabId, text: fullItineraryText });
console.log("Insert result:", insertRes);

await tool.wait_for({ tabId, condition: "dom_settled", timeout_ms: 3000 });

args.code:
const tabId = 2136412319;

const fullItineraryText = `=====================================================
SAN FRANCISCO CHRISTMAS TRIP ITINERARY (DEC 23 - 26, 2026)
Origin: Pittsburgh (PIT) | Destination: San Francisco (SFO)
=====================================================

1. SELECTED FLIGHT & TRAVEL LOGISTICS
-----------------------------------------------------
Recommended Flight: United Airlines Round-Trip (Nonstop)
• Outbound: Wednesday, Dec 23, 2026
  - Departs PIT: 7:23 AM
  - Arrives SFO: 10:25 AM
  - Flight UA 583 | Nonstop | 6h 02m
  - Advantage: Nonstop flight arriving mid-morning (10:25 AM), leaving the entire afternoon and evening free in San Francisco!
• Return: Saturday, Dec 26, 2026
  - Departs SFO: 9:28 PM
  - Arrives PIT: 5:21 AM (+1)
  - Nonstop | 4h 53m
  - Advantage: Late evening departure allows for a full extra day in SF.
• Total Price: $522 round-trip (Basic Economy) / $652 (Standard Economy with carry-on and seat selection).

Alternative Flight Options Reviewed on Google Flights:
• Delta (1-stop via Detroit DTW): PIT 10:31 AM -> SFO 2:30 PM (6h 59m total, 31m layover, $689). Good afternoon arrival option if a later morning departure from PIT is preferred.
• United (1-stop via Chicago ORD): PIT 8:45 AM -> SFO 1:34 PM (7h 49m total, 40m layover, $578).
• United Nonstop Evening: PIT 5:20 PM -> SFO 8:10 PM (5h 50m, $559).

-----------------------------------------------------
2. RECOMMENDED HOTEL
-----------------------------------------------------
Hotel: Fairmont San Francisco (4-Star Historic Luxury)
• Address: 950 Mason Street, Nob Hill, San Francisco, CA 94108
• Nightly Rate: $360 / night (under the $400 budget, fantastic rate for Christmas week)
• Guest Rating: 4.5 / 5.0 (7,600+ Google reviews)
• Neighborhood: Nob Hill (central, prestigious, panoramic views)
• Why It's the Best Choice for Christmas:
  1. Iconic Christmas Centerpiece: Home to the world-famous two-story, life-sized Gingerbread House (built with real gingerbread bricks and royal icing) and a 23-foot lobby Christmas tree.
  2. Public Transit Connection: The historic California Street Cable Car line stops right outside the front doors at California & Mason, providing direct transit down to the Embarcadero, Ferry Building, and Financial District.
  3. Proximity: Easy access to Chinatown, North Beach, Union Square, and the waterfront.
  4. On-site historic venues including the Tonga Room & Hurricane Bar and the Laurel Court.

Alternative Hotels Screened:
• Staypineapple Union Square: 4.5★ | $137/night
• citizenM Union Square: 4.5★ | $120/night
• Marines' Memorial Club: 4.5★ | $110/night

-----------------------------------------------------
3. THREE-DAY TRIP ITINERARY (DECEMBER 23 - 25, 2026)
-----------------------------------------------------
All travel legs are kept under 30 minutes with ample buffer time and logical geographical clustering.

DAY 1: WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 23 – ARRIVAL, NOB HILL & WATERFRONT
• 10:25 AM: Flight lands at SFO Airport.
• 10:45 AM - 11:30 AM: Transfer to Nob Hill. Take BART Yellow Line from SFO Airport station directly to Powell St Station (~30 min transit), then a short cable car/taxi up to the hotel; or take a direct 25-minute rideshare.
• 11:30 AM - 1:00 PM: Check in and drop luggage at Fairmont San Francisco (950 Mason St). Explore the grand lobby and marvel at the life-sized Gingerbread House.
• 1:00 PM - 1:25 PM: [PUBLIC TRANSIT SEGMENT] Board the California Street Cable Car directly outside the Fairmont on California & Mason. Enjoy the scenic ride down California Street through the Financial District straight to the Embarcadero (~15 mins).
• 1:25 PM - 4:00 PM: Ferry Building Marketplace & Embarcadero.
  - Explore artisanal food stalls in the historic 1898 building.
  - Lunch: Fresh seafood at Hog Island Oyster Co. or artisan empanadas at El Porteño.
  - Coffee: Blue Bottle Coffee (their flagship Ferry Building cafe).
  - Walk along the scenic waterfront Embarcadero Promenade.
• 4:00 PM - 4:20 PM: Travel to Telegraph Hill (15-min Muni bus #39 or short rideshare).
• 4:20 PM - 5:45 PM: [SCENIC VIEWPOINT] Coit Tower (Pioneer Park).
  - 360-degree sunset panoramic views of San Francisco Bay, Alcatraz, the Golden Gate Bridge, and downtown skyline.
  - View the historic 1930s New Deal WPA frescoes on the ground floor.
• 5:45 PM - 6:00 PM: Stroll down through historic North Beach and into Chinatown (15 min walk).
• 6:00 PM - 8:30 PM: [MICHELIN RESTAURANT] Mister Jiu's (28 Waverly Pl, Chinatown).
  - 1 Michelin Star modern Cantonese dining by Chef Brandon Jew.
  - Located in historic Chinatown, just a scenic 10-minute walk back up to the Fairmont on Nob Hill.
• 8:30 PM+: Evening holiday drinks at the Tonga Room or cozy fireplace lounge at the Fairmont.

DAY 2: THURSDAY, DECEMBER 24 (CHRISTMAS EVE) – ALCATRAZ & NORTH BEACH
• 8:30 AM - 9:30 AM: Morning stroll down to North Beach. Breakfast at historic Liguria Bakery (1700 Stockton St - famous Italian focaccia) or Caffè Trieste (601 Vallejo St - birthplace of West Coast espresso).
• 9:30 AM - 9:45 AM: Short 10-minute walk or ride to Pier 33 Alcatraz Landing.
• 9:45 AM - 1:00 PM: [MAJOR ATTRACTION] Alcatraz Island Tour.
  - Take the 10:00 AM Alcatraz City Cruises ferry across the bay.
  - Award-winning self-guided "Doing Time" audio tour of the cellhouse.
  - Explore the historic grounds, lighthouse, and dramatic city skyline views.
  - Ferry back to Pier 33 arrives around 12:45 PM.
• 1:00 PM - 2:30 PM: Fisherman's Wharf & Pier 39. Lunch at Boudin Bakery Cafe (clam chowder in sourdough bread bowls) or fresh Dungeness crab at Scoma's.
• 2:45 PM - 5:00 PM: Afternoon holiday exploration of North Beach and Nob Hill.
  - Browse City Lights Booksellers and historic Columbus Ave.
  - Return to Fairmont to relax and refresh for Christmas Eve. (Travel leg ~12 mins).
• 5:30 PM - 8:00 PM: [FINE DINING] Christmas Eve Dinner at Gary Danko (800 N Point St, Michelin-recommended fine dining) or holiday feast at Laurel Court at Fairmont.
• 8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Holiday evening cable car ride along Powell-Mason line to see the giant Union Square Christmas Tree and holiday window displays.

DAY 3: FRIDAY, DECEMBER 25 (CHRISTMAS DAY) – GOLDEN GATE & PANORAMIC VISTAS
• 8:45 AM - 9:15 AM: Morning drive/rideshare west to Inner Richmond (~15 min drive).
